symbolic_mapping: bold color and form as assertion of presence
glasses as mediation between self and world

alternative_interpretations: The attire may simply reflect personal taste or practical cold-weather dressing without symbolic intent.
limitations: No textual or contextual cues confirm intentional symbolism; interpretation relies solely on formal visual choices.

symbolic_mapping: seasonal barrenness as metaphor for temporal passage
visible aging as evidence of lived duration

alternative_interpretations: The background is incidental; the subject’s expression is neutral and not clearly contemplative.
limitations: Facial expression is ambiguous and does not confirm introspection; seasonality is inferred from leafless branches only.
